shortBulletSummary: Iran-US tensions escalate, oil past $100. Bitcoin tracks gold, not equities, showing resilience.
$246M in crypto liquidations over 24 hours; Bitcoin around $79K with increased volatility.
Crypto Fear & Greed Index at 69 ('Greed') despite rising macro risks.
Iran eases currency controls, allowing exporters to use crypto for imports, circumventing sanctions.
